'''San''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was the owner of [[Mechanical Allies]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] shop on [[Sel Zonn Station]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], San was able to keep his business open under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] despite his nonhuman status and untrustworthy nature.
